description: A formerly unconditional local binding becomes conditional while a later return still dereferences it.
diff_text:
diff --git a/service.py b/service.py
--- a/service.py
+++ b/service.py
@@ -1,3 +1,4 @@
 def render(enabled):
-    value = build_value()
+    if enabled:
+        value = build_value()
     return value.serialize()

expected_findings.evidence: When enabled is false, value is never initialized before the return expression.

reproduction_instructions: Call render(False); Python raises UnboundLocalError before serialize can run.
known_limitations: The helper build_value is intentionally not executed; the failure is established before its result is needed.

description: Both conditional paths initialize the local before it is returned.
diff_text:
diff --git a/service.py b/service.py
--- a/service.py
+++ b/service.py
@@ -1,3 +1,6 @@
 def render(enabled):
-    value = build_value()
+    if enabled:
+        value = build_value()
+    else:
+        value = build_value()
     return value.serialize()
reproduction_instructions: Stub build_value with an object exposing serialize and call render(True) and render(False).
known_limitations: The case verifies only local initialization semantics.
